title: Contact
content:
Have a question about this example or the Guchho Blogger plugin? Use the details below as a starting point for your own contact page.

Project questions

For plugin questions, open an issue in the project repository with a short description, the template snippet involved and the command you ran.

Template feedback

If something in the preview looks wrong, include the generated route and any diagnostic shown by the build. That usually makes the cause much easier to trace.

Replace these paragraphs with your own contact details before publishing a real site.
